**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`  _(via viewType (symbol, a field of const object LIST_VIEW_PAGE_ALIAS_GUIDANCE; a field of const object LIST_VIEW_RETIRED_ALIASES), viewType (literal, a string literal in LIST_VIEW_PAGE_ALIAS_GUIDANCE; a string literal in LIST_VIEW_RETIRED_ALIASES; a string literal in apply))_

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object), viewType (symbol, a field of const object LIST_VIEW_PAGE_ALIAS_GUIDANCE; a field of const object LIST_VIEW_RETIRED_ALIASES), viewType (literal, a string literal in LIST_VIEW_PAGE_ALIAS_GUIDANCE; a string literal in LIST_VIEW_RETIRED_ALIASES; a string literal in apply))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object), retiredAfter (symbol, a field of const object pageListViewObjectNameViewTypeToDataType), retiredFromLoadPath (symbol, a field of const object pageListViewObjectNameViewTypeToDataType))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`, `packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `objectName (symbol, 39 pages)`, `objectName (literal, 39 pages)`
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **143** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6ec0e1222812996230b312da753a592026eaf6d9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `dce94ca12a2cbf606945c90389c70800196ea7ca` — the merge of head `e55aa1bfce055fae9fd16db9a9413f34d4084021` into base `6ec0e1222812996230b312da753a592026eaf6d9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin dce94ca12a2cbf606945c90389c70800196ea7ca && git checkout dce94ca12a2cbf606945c90389c70800196ea7ca
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6ec0e1222812996230b312da753a592026eaf6d9 e55aa1bfce055fae9fd16db9a9413f34d4084021 && git checkout -B drift-repro 6ec0e1222812996230b312da753a592026eaf6d9 && git merge --no-ff e55aa1bfce055fae9fd16db9a9413f34d4084021

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6ec0e1222812996230b312da753a592026eaf6d9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6ec0e1222812996230b312da753a592026eaf6d9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`ComponentPropsMap` gains the key `'list-view'`** (exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui`): the published key set widens, `ComponentProps` of `'list-view'` now resolves. 2. **The row's accept set** is `ListViewSchema.shape` by reference (strict, every member the authoring list view declares; `name` / `label` optional, so an empty bag passes), `columns` made optional (`shape.columns.optional()`), `options` taken by reference from `VIEW_METADATA_MEMBERS.listOverlay.shape.options` (the per-kind judged bag; `options.grid` refused with its existing guidance), and both object-level checks attached (`checkListViewCalendarVisualization`, `checkListViewChartBinding`). Right, and exactly the dispatch shape of `6238503560`.
3. **`objectName` / `viewType` undeclared, answered by name** through the row's `guidance`, quoting `LIST_VIEW_RETIRED_ALIASES` notes verbatim. Right: one prescription for both tiers, as ruled.
4. **The props gate narrows for `type: 'list-view'` nodes.** `validateComponentProps` dispatches on map rows (`PROPS_SCHEMAS[type]`, skip when absent): before this head a page `list-view` node drew 0 findings whatever its bag; after it, every key outside the row and every value verdict is `severity: 'error'`, and the rule is `tier: 'gating'`, `commands: ALL`, on the runtime page door (`authoring-rules.ts`, ruling 6161173492). So `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` refuse, and a Studio / REST / MCP page save carrying `objectName`, `viewType`, `kanban.groupField` or `options.grid` on a `list-view` is refused until rewritten. Right as a mechanism (no dispatch, tier or door change in the diff) and this is the accept-set narrowing ② must carry.
5. **`PageSchema` / `PageComponentSchema` accept set unchanged** (open `properties` record, the 2026-08-05 ruling), pinned in `component-list-view-row.test.ts`. Right.
6. **The type door is unmoved.** `validateComponentTypes` judges only reserved-namespace types (`hasReservedComponentNamespace` guard); `list-view` has no colon prefix and rode the open arm before and after. The row neither widens nor narrows `component-type-unknown`. Right.
7. **`PRINT_REFUSED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` gains `list-view`** with the `object-grid` reason. The print census pin (every vocabulary member is printable or refused, never both) trips on a new map key; before, `list-view` in a print page was refused by the generic "not in the printable block subset" clause, now by its own reason. Print accept set unchanged. Right.
8. **The refused-stored-shape detector `view-data-api-provider-retired` now reaches page `list-view` nodes.** `componentApiBindingRefusal` reads `ComponentPropsMap[type].shape.data`, so with no row it returned `undefined`: a stored `list-view` node binding the retired `api` provider was NOT listed before and IS listed now. New reach in the right direction, and the `surface` strings (`refused-shapes.ts`, the D3 entry) now name it. Right; the PR body's "it reported the node anyway" overstates, the widening is this PR's.
9. **`REACT_RETIRED_OVERLAY_PROPS.ListView` published value unchanged**: the two entries moved byte-identical to `ui/list-view-retired-aliases.ts`, a leaf outside the `ui` barrel (the `list-view-export-options.ts` precedent); `react-blocks.ts` reads `ComponentPropsMap` at module load for `RECORD_CONTEXT_BLOCK_TAGS`, so the row cannot import it. Identity pinned with `toBe`. `check:react-blocks` ran in `Type Check · source gates`, success. Right.
10. **`RECORD_CONTEXT_BLOCK_TAGS`** derives from `Object.keys(ComponentPropsMap)` filtered to `record:*`; `list-view` is not one, so the react publish gate is unmoved. Right.
11. **D2 conversion `page-list-view-object-name-view-type-to-data-type`** (toMajor 18, order 68, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`, the value 30 sibling step-18 entries carry; spec at `18.0.0-next.3`). Consumer at the pin `5e15928b46`: `plugin-list/src/index.tsx` registers `list-view` with `data` / `type` inputs and `defaultProps.data`, and states `objectName` / `viewType` are neither published nor read, so the conversion's target spelling is what the pinned console reads. Right; the ruling's mapping, with the conflict guard the ruling did not spell out but ADR-0087 requires.
12. **D3 entry and step-18 fragment** (`conversionIds` join; fragment order 101, unique; duplicate orders already exist on `main`, so uniqueness is not an invariant), plus the `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` JOIN gaining the two refusals. 15. **Hold-offs respected:** `.objectui-sha`, objectui, `PageSchema`'s accept set and `validate-component-props.ts` untouched. Runtime strings carry no tracker number (`Lint · docs & code guards`, success). Commit trailers are the model-free pair on all 9 commits.

### ② Semver level

**Does not match what the diff publishes.** The changeset is `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, a plain `feat(spec):` summary, no BREAKING line and no ADR-0087 disposition marker. What the diff publishes (judgment 4) is an accept-set narrowing at two error-tier doors: an authored page `list-view` node that passed `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and the Studio / REST / MCP page save at `d9a749bae` is refused at this head, with one named external producer (hotcrm 4.0.1, 4 nodes) and 0 in-repo producers. Under AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3 the arm is `(narrowing)`, `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, and a breaking changeset carries its migration (the FROM → TO text is already in the body) and exactly one disposition marker. The three same-class page-row narrowings landed since the error tier each declared it: #23331 (`1623fafc3`), #23425 (`775ed65e2`), #23494 (`ad5a7d7c3`), all `!` summary, BREAKING line, registered marker, `minor` under the launch-window convention. `check-adr-0087-registration` is green on this head only because the changeset declares nothing breaking; its own header says silence is the one thing it cannot see.

If the maintainer instead answers A on #24219, that answer is the ruling of record for this item and a record re-rendered on this head carries it as the ② basis.

`Clause-②:` line on the PR body: `yes` (no arm), well-formed; the changeset carries the arm, and that arm is what is wrong.
